summary: This Form 6-K filing by Nokia Corporation reports routine manager share transactions under EU Market Abuse Regulation. Four senior managers acquired small volumes of Nokia shares on May 15, 2026, at EUR 12.0876 per share on NASDAQ Helsinki. The filing involves no corporate transaction, board recommendation, or strategic event. It is a regulatory disclosure of insider trading, not a special situation. As a non-US filing, it serves as the equivalent of a Form 4 filing in the US. No deal terms, premium, or closing timeline are present. What to watch: routine compliance disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
